project.name: AI Ad Agency for {niche}
project.description: Build a complete AI-fulfilled ad agency targeting {niche} using a computer-use AI agent. Covers brand creation, competitive research, ad creative generation, ad deployment, lead generation, and automated outreach. Revenue target: {revenue_target}/month at {price_per_client}/month per client.

variables.niche: The target industry/business type (e.g., car dealerships, restaurants, real estate agents, dentists)
variables.niche_slug: URL-safe version of the niche (e.g., car-dealerships, restaurants, real-estate)
variables.niche_tag: Short tag for the niche (e.g., automotive, food-service, real-estate, dental)
variables.location: Target geographic area (e.g., Kansas City, MO or Austin, TX)
variables.num_clients_target: Number of clients needed for revenue target (e.g., 4)
variables.client_website: A real client or prospect website URL for testing ad generation
variables.brand_guide_doc: Reference to the brand style guide created in Step 2
variables.strategy_doc: Reference to the competitive strategy playbook from Step 3
variables.ad_creatives_from_step_5: Reference to the ad creatives generated in Step 5
variables.dealership_name: Replace with the generic client business name
variables.dealership_address: Replace with the client's physical address for geo-targeting
variables.calendar_booking_link: Your Calendly or scheduling tool link
variables.prospect_spreadsheet_from_step_7: Reference to the prospect spreadsheet from Step 7
variables.check_interval: How often to check for new inventory (e.g., every hour, every 6 hours)
variables.ad_platform: Primary ad platform (e.g., Meta, Google, TikTok)
variables.outreach_platform: Platform for outreach (e.g., Instagram, LinkedIn, Email)

steps.title: Niche Selection & Positioning
steps.description: Identify and validate {niche} as the target niche for your AI ad agency. The ideal niche has businesses that already spend money on advertising, have recurring needs for new creative, and operate in a market where ad performance directly drives revenue. Define the agency positioning, pricing model, and revenue target.
steps.prompt:
I'm building an AI-fulfilled ad agency. I need you to help me validate and define the niche.

Target niche: {niche}

Please analyze this niche and create a positioning document that includes:

1. **Niche Validation**:
   - Why {niche} are ideal clients for an AI ad agency
   - Average monthly ad spend for a typical business in {niche}
   - Pain points these businesses face with their current advertising
   - How frequently they need new ad creatives and why

2. **Agency Positioning**:
   - Agency name suggestion (something that conveys AI + {niche} + performance)
   - One-line value proposition
   - 3-5 key differentiators vs traditional agencies
   - Why AI fulfillment is specifically advantageous for {niche} ads

3. **Revenue Model**:
   - Recommended monthly retainer price per client
   - Services included at that price point
   - Number of clients needed to hit {revenue_target}/month
   - Upsell opportunities (additional services at higher tiers)

4. **Ideal Client Profile**:
   - Business size (small independent vs large chain/franchise)
   - Geographic focus (local, regional, national)
   - Current advertising maturity level
   - Decision maker title and typical objections

Format this as a clean strategy document I can reference throughout the agency build.
steps.expectedOutput: A comprehensive niche validation and positioning document covering: niche analysis with market data, agency brand positioning with name and value proposition, revenue model with pricing tiers and client targets, and ideal client profile with qualification criteria. Should be 2-3 pages and serve as the strategic foundation for all subsequent steps.
steps.notes:
ADAPT FOR YOUR NICHE:
- Research the total addressable market (TAM) for {niche} in your geography
- Identify industry-specific regulations that affect advertising (e.g., healthcare HIPAA, financial services compliance)
- Find the industry association or trade group for {niche} (useful for credibility and lead generation)
- Define 3 pricing tiers instead of a single price point
- Create a 'niche scoring rubric' you can reuse to evaluate other niches later
- Consider adjacent niches you could expand into
- Document seasonal patterns specific to {niche}

subSteps.title: Research {niche} Ad Spend
subSteps.description: Search for data on average advertising budgets and spending patterns for businesses in {niche}.
subSteps.prompt: Search the web for recent data on advertising budgets and spending patterns for {niche}. I need: average monthly ad spend by business size, what percentage goes to digital vs traditional, which platforms they use most (Meta, Google, etc.), and any industry reports. Compile findings into a brief research summary.

subSteps.title: Scan Existing Agencies Serving {niche}
subSteps.description: Identify 5-10 agencies that already serve {niche} to understand competitive positioning and pricing.
subSteps.prompt: Search for agencies that specialize in advertising for {niche}. Find 5-10 examples and for each, note: their pricing (if public), services offered, how they position themselves, whether they use AI, and any client testimonials. Create a competitive landscape table.

subSteps.title: Define Pricing Tiers
subSteps.description: Create a tiered pricing model based on competitive research and the value delivered.
subSteps.prompt:
Based on the competitive research, design a 3-tier pricing model for our AI ad agency targeting {niche}:
- Starter tier: Basic ad creation and deployment
- Growth tier: Full service with competitive research and optimization
- Enterprise tier: Everything plus automated monitoring and continuous ad generation

For each tier, define: monthly price, included services, ad volume limits, reporting frequency, and the ideal client size it targets. Anchor the Growth tier at {price_per_client}/month.

steps.title: Brand Style Guide Creation
steps.description: Create a comprehensive brand style guide that will govern all visual and copy elements produced by the agency. This ensures every ad creative, landing page, and client deliverable has a consistent, professional look. The style guide becomes the foundation that the AI references when generating any creative asset.
steps.prompt:
Create a comprehensive brand style guide for my AI-powered advertising agency targeting {niche}. The agency name is "{agency_name}" (or suggest a name if I haven't chosen one yet).

The style guide must include:

1. **Brand Identity**:
   - Agency name and tagline
   - Brand story (2-3 sentences on what we do and why)
   - Brand personality traits
   - Tone of voice guidelines (how we speak in ads, emails, and client communications)

2. **Color Palette**:
   - Primary color with hex code (should convey trust and performance for {niche})
   - Secondary color with hex code
   - Accent color with hex code (for CTAs and highlights)
   - Neutral colors with hex codes
   - Example color combinations for different ad types

3. **Typography**:
   - Primary font family for headlines
   - Secondary font family for body copy
   - Font sizes for: main headline, sub-headline, body, CTA, fine print
   - Font weight guidelines

4. **Visual Guidelines**:
   - Image treatment rules (filters, overlays, borders)
   - Layout templates for common ad sizes (1080x1080, 1200x628, 1080x1920)
   - Logo placement rules
   - White space and margin guidelines
   - Do's and Don'ts

5. **Ad Copy Framework**:
   - Headline formulas (3-5 proven patterns for {niche})
   - CTA button text options ranked by urgency
   - Tone spectrum (when to be urgent vs informational vs aspirational)
   - Industry-specific language: words to always use / words to never use
   - Legal disclaimer templates relevant to {niche}

Save this as a structured document I can reference in every future step.
steps.expectedOutput: A complete brand style guide document (3-5 pages) with specific hex codes, font selections, layout rules, copy frameworks, and visual guidelines. Should be immediately usable as a reference document for all creative work. The guide should feel premium and tailored to {niche}.
steps.notes:
ADAPT FOR YOUR NICHE:
- Research color psychology specific to {niche} (e.g., healthcare uses blues/greens for trust, food uses reds/yellows for appetite)
- Include industry-specific compliance requirements in the copy framework
- Create both a 'client-facing' version and an 'internal AI generation' version
- Include responsive design guidelines for mobile, desktop, and in-feed
- Create a per-client brand overlay template that adapts the agency guide for individual clients
- Add social media profile templates
- Build a 'brand compliance checklist' the AI runs through before finalizing any creative

subSteps.title: Research Color Psychology for {niche}
subSteps.description: Research which colors perform best in advertising for {niche} and why.
subSteps.prompt: Search for research on color psychology in {niche} advertising. Which colors are most associated with trust, performance, and conversion in this industry? Look at what top brands in {niche} use and what colors top-performing ads tend to feature. Summarize findings with specific hex code recommendations.

subSteps.title: Generate the Full Style Guide
subSteps.description: Use the research to create the complete brand style guide document.
subSteps.prompt: Using the color psychology research and {niche} advertising best practices, create the full brand style guide as specified in the main step prompt. Make sure every element has a specific, concrete value (exact hex codes, exact font names, exact pixel sizes). Do not use vague language - specify exact values.

subSteps.title: Create Per-Client Brand Overlay Template
subSteps.description: Create a template that adapts the agency brand guide for individual clients.
subSteps.prompt: Create a 'Client Brand Overlay' template document. This is a shorter version of our brand guide that gets customized per client. It should have fill-in sections for: business name, business logo, brand colors (if they have them), specific products/services to highlight, geographic area, and any compliance requirements. The template should show how the client's brand elements merge with our agency's framework.

steps.title: Competitive Intelligence ({ad_platform} Ad Library Research)
steps.description: Conduct deep competitive research by scanning the {ad_platform} Ad Library for active ads from businesses in {niche}. The AI agent opens a browser, navigates to the ad library, and searches for competitors one by one, cataloging their ad strategies, copy patterns, visual approaches, and offer structures. The output is a comprehensive strategy playbook for the agency.
steps.prompt:
I need you to conduct competitive intelligence research on {niche} advertising using the {ad_platform} Ad Library.

Here is what I need you to do:

1. Open your browser and go to the ad library: {ad_library_url}
2. Search for 20 businesses in {niche} (one at a time). Choose a mix of:
   - 10 large/well-known businesses in {niche} (national brands)
   - 5 successful local/regional businesses in {niche}
   - 5 businesses near {location} (our target market)

3. For each business, catalog:
   - Number of active ads
   - Types of offers being promoted
   - Visual style and layout patterns
   - Copy tone and messaging patterns
   - Call-to-action language
   - Any unique or standout creative approaches

4. After scanning all 20, compile a comprehensive strategy document that covers:
   - **Seasonal/Event Patterns**: What seasonal hooks or events drive ad campaigns in {niche}?
   - **Offer Structures**: How do they structure discounts, promotions, or special offers?
   - **Urgency & Scarcity Tactics**: What language creates urgency in {niche} advertising?
   - **Social Proof Patterns**: How do they use testimonials, reviews, or case studies in ads?
   - **Visual Layout Patterns**: What layouts and image styles perform well?
   - **CTA Patterns**: What calls-to-action are most common and effective?
   - **Copy Formulas**: Document 5-10 proven headline and body copy formulas
   - **Ad Format Preferences**: Single image vs carousel vs video - what is most common?
   - **Industry-Specific Tactics**: What strategies are unique to {niche}?
   - **Compliance Observations**: Any regulatory patterns or required disclaimers?

Format this as a professional strategy playbook document.
steps.expectedOutput: A 5-8 page competitive intelligence strategy document organized by tactic category. Should include specific examples from real ads, proven copy formulas, visual layout recommendations, and a prioritized list of strategies ranked by frequency. This becomes the agency's core strategic playbook.
steps.notes:
ADAPT FOR YOUR NICHE:
- Identify the specific seasonal patterns that matter for {niche}
- Research industry-specific regulations that affect ad content and claims
- Also scan Google Ads Transparency Center if search ads are important for {niche}
- Consider scanning TikTok, YouTube, or LinkedIn ads depending on where {niche} audiences spend time
- Save screenshots of the best ads as a swipe file
- Track ad longevity - ads running for months are likely profitable
- Run this research quarterly to keep the playbook current

subSteps.title: Scan National/Large Brands in {niche}
subSteps.description: Research the top 10 large brands in {niche} in the ad library.
subSteps.prompt: Open the ad library at {ad_library_url} and search for 10 large/well-known businesses in {niche}. For each, note the number of active ads, types of offers, visual style, copy tone, and standout creatives. Take detailed notes.

subSteps.title: Scan Local and Regional Businesses in {niche}
subSteps.description: Research 10 local/regional businesses in {niche}, focusing on the target market area.
subSteps.prompt: Continue in the ad library and search for 10 more businesses in {niche}: 5 successful regional businesses and 5 near {location}. Same process: catalog active ads, offers, visual patterns, copy tone, and standout creatives.

subSteps.title: Compile Strategy Playbook
subSteps.description: Synthesize all research into a structured strategy playbook document.
subSteps.prompt: Using all notes from scanning 20 businesses, compile a comprehensive strategy playbook. Organize by tactic category: seasonal patterns, offer structures, urgency/scarcity, social proof, visual layouts, CTAs, copy formulas, ad formats, and industry-specific tactics. Include examples, rank tactics by frequency, and add recommendations. This should be 5-8 pages.

subSteps.title: Create Ad Swipe File
subSteps.description: Save the 10 best ads found as a reference swipe file.
subSteps.prompt: From all ads reviewed, identify the 10 best. For each, save a screenshot or detailed description and explain why it works: tactic used, why the copy is effective, what makes the visual compelling, and how to adapt it. Organize as a 'Swipe File' reference document.

steps.title: Sales Infrastructure (Store Page + Checkout)
steps.description: Build the sales infrastructure needed to sell the agency's services: a professional landing page explaining the service, pricing display, calendar booking for sales calls, and a checkout flow for the {price_per_client}/month retainer.
steps.prompt:
I need you to build the sales infrastructure for my AI ad agency targeting {niche}. Here is what I need:

1. **Landing Page / Store Page**:
   Build a professional landing page for "{agency_name}" that includes:
   - Hero section with a compelling headline and sub-headline for {niche}
   - "What You Get" section listing all services included
   - Social proof section (placeholder for testimonials and case studies)
   - Pricing section showing the {price_per_client}/month plan clearly
   - FAQ section addressing common objections from {niche} businesses
   - Calendar booking widget for scheduling a demo call
   - Footer with contact information

2. **Checkout / Payment Link**:
   Create a checkout page or payment link for {price_per_client}/month recurring subscription. Use Stripe (or available payment platform). The checkout should:
   - Clearly state what the client is purchasing
   - Show the monthly price
   - Collect business name and contact info
   - Process the recurring payment

3. **Calendar Booking**:
   Set up a calendar booking system where prospects can book a 30-minute demo call. Configure:
   - Available hours (Mon-Fri, 9am-5pm)
   - 30-minute meeting duration
   - Confirmation and reminder emails

Follow the brand style guide: {brand_guide_doc}

Make it look premium and professional. {niche} businesses are used to dealing with polished vendors.
steps.expectedOutput: A live landing page with hero, services, pricing, FAQ, and calendar booking. A working checkout link for {price_per_client}/month. A configured calendar booking system. All elements should follow the brand style guide.
steps.notes:
ADAPT FOR YOUR NICHE:
- Customize the FAQ section with objections specific to {niche}
- Add an ROI calculator relevant to {niche} (e.g., 'If you get X more customers per month at $Y average value...')
- Create a niche-specific case study page (even with projected/mock data initially)
- Build a 'Free Ad Audit' or 'Free Assessment' lead magnet specific to {niche}
- Include industry-specific social proof (logos, certifications, partnerships)
- Set up email sequences for post-booking and post-call follow-up

subSteps.title: Build Landing Page
subSteps.description: Create the main agency landing page with all sections tailored to {niche}.
subSteps.prompt: Build a professional landing page for '{agency_name}' using our brand style guide. Include: hero section with a headline targeting {niche}, services list, pricing ({price_per_client}/mo), FAQ section with {niche}-specific objections, and placeholder for calendar booking. Make it mobile-responsive and premium.

subSteps.title: Set Up Payment Processing
subSteps.description: Create a checkout link for {price_per_client}/month recurring subscription.
subSteps.prompt: Open Stripe (or available payment platform) and create a recurring payment link for {price_per_client}/month. Product name: '{agency_name} - Monthly Retainer'. Add a description of included services. Generate a shareable checkout link and embed it on the landing page.

subSteps.title: Configure Calendar Booking
subSteps.description: Set up scheduling tool for prospect demo calls.
subSteps.prompt: Open Calendly (or similar) and create a '30-Minute Agency Demo' event type. Set availability to Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, enable confirmation and reminder emails, and add a booking page description explaining what the demo covers for {niche} businesses. Get the embed code and add it to the landing page.

subSteps.title: Create Lead Magnet
subSteps.description: Build a free assessment or audit offer as a low-friction entry point.
subSteps.prompt: Create a 'Free Ad Audit' page or form for {niche} businesses. The form should collect: business name, website URL, current monthly ad spend (range), biggest advertising challenge, and contact email. This gives us a reason to reach out and demonstrates value. Add as a secondary CTA on the landing page.

steps.title: Ad Creative Generation (The Core Service)
steps.description: The core service delivery step. Take a real client's website, scrape their actual products/services/inventory, and generate professional ad creatives using the brand style guide and competitive strategy playbook. The key differentiator is 100% data accuracy - zero hallucinated information.
steps.prompt:
I need you to create ad creatives for a real {niche} client. Here is the information:

**Client Website**: {client_website}
**Brand Style Guide**: {brand_guide_doc}
**Strategy Playbook**: {strategy_doc}

Here is what I need you to do:

1. **Scrape Current Products/Services/Inventory**:
   - Visit {client_website} and navigate to their offerings
   - Pull detailed data for 10-15 products, services, or listings
   - CRITICAL: Use ONLY real data from the website. Do NOT fabricate or hallucinate any details, prices, or information. Every data point must be verifiable.

2. **Generate Ad Creatives** (create 5-8 different ads):
   Using the brand style guide and strategy playbook, create:
   
   a. **Single Product/Service Spotlight** (2 ads): Feature one high-value offering with full details and a direct response CTA
   b. **Multi-Product Showcase** (1 ad): Grid or carousel showing 3-4 offerings
   c. **Seasonal/Event Ad** (1 ad): Tie to the nearest relevant seasonal event
   d. **Special Offer Ad** (1 ad): Focus on the best current deal, discount, or promotion
   e. **Social Proof Ad** (1 ad): Lead with reviews, results, or testimonials
   f. **Urgency/Scarcity Ad** (1-2 ads): Limited time or limited availability format

3. **For Each Ad, Provide**:
   - Headline (under 40 characters for Meta)
   - Primary text (125 characters visible, up to 500 total)
   - Description text
   - CTA button text
   - Image description or layout specification
   - Link URL (back to the specific page on the client website)
   - Target audience notes (age range, geographic radius, interests)

4. **Quality Checklist**:
   - [ ] All data matches the client website exactly
   - [ ] All prices/offers are current and accurate
   - [ ] Ad copy follows the brand style guide tone
   - [ ] Strategies used match the competitive playbook
   - [ ] CTAs are clear and action-oriented
   - [ ] No misleading claims or compliance issues
   - [ ] Geographic targeting is appropriate
steps.expectedOutput: 5-8 complete ad creatives ready for deployment, each with headline, primary text, description, CTA, image specs, and targeting notes. All data must be 100% accurate from the real client website. Include a data verification table.
steps.notes:
ADAPT FOR YOUR NICHE:
- Identify what 'inventory' means for {niche} (products? services? listings? menu items?)
- Include industry-specific compliance requirements for ad content
- Create ads in multiple sizes: 1080x1080 (feed), 1200x628 (link), 1080x1920 (story/reel)
- Generate A/B test variants with different headlines or CTAs
- Add video ad scripts in addition to static creatives if relevant for {niche}
- Include retargeting ad variants for website visitors who didn't convert
- Consider which ad platform(s) are most effective for {niche}

subSteps.title: Scrape Client Website Data
subSteps.description: Visit the client website and extract real product/service/inventory data.
subSteps.prompt: Visit {client_website} and navigate to their products, services, or listings. Extract data for 10-15 items including: names, descriptions, prices, current promotions, and key details. Organize into a structured table. CRITICAL: Only use data actually on the website.

subSteps.title: Create Spotlight Ads
subSteps.description: Generate 2 spotlight ads featuring individual high-value offerings.
subSteps.prompt: Using the scraped data, select the 2 most compelling items and create a Spotlight ad for each. Follow the brand style guide. Each ad needs: headline, primary text, description, CTA, image layout, and correct URL. Use specificity and real data.

subSteps.title: Create Remaining Ad Types
subSteps.description: Generate the remaining 4-6 ad creatives covering different strategy types.
subSteps.prompt: Create: 1 multi-product showcase, 1 seasonal/event ad, 1 special offer ad, 1 social proof ad, and 1-2 urgency/scarcity ads. Use real data, follow the brand guide, apply playbook tactics. Each needs full copy, CTA, image specs, and targeting notes.

subSteps.title: Verify Data Accuracy
subSteps.description: Cross-check all ad creatives against the client website for accuracy.
subSteps.prompt: Revisit {client_website} and verify every data point in the ad creatives. Create a verification table: each claim, its source URL, and pass/fail status. Flag any discrepancies. This is critical for trust and compliance.

steps.title: Ad Deployment to {ad_platform} Ads Manager
steps.description: Deploy the finished ad creatives into {ad_platform} Ads Manager. The AI opens Ads Manager in the browser, creates a campaign, uploads creatives, fills in all copy fields, configures targeting including geographic radius, and sets up the complete campaign. The only human action needed is clicking 'Publish'.
steps.prompt:
Now upload these ad creatives into my {ad_platform} Ads Manager account and set up the campaigns.

Ad creatives to deploy: {ad_creatives_from_step_5}

**Campaign Setup**:

1. Open {ad_platform} Ads Manager in the browser
2. Create a new campaign:
   - Name: "{client_name} - {agency_name} - {current_month} {current_year}"
   - Objective: Traffic (or Conversions if pixel is set up)
   - Budget: ${daily_budget}/day
   - Schedule: Start immediately, no end date

3. Create ad sets (one per ad type):
   - Geographic targeting: {radius}-mile radius around {client_address}
   - Age targeting: appropriate for {niche}
   - Interest targeting: relevant to {niche}
   - Placements: Automatic
   - Optimization: Link clicks

4. For each ad:
   - Upload creative images
   - Fill in headline, primary text, description
   - Set CTA button
   - Set destination URL with UTM parameters

5. Save as DRAFT - do NOT publish. Leave for my review.
steps.expectedOutput: A fully configured ad campaign in draft status with all ad sets and ads properly set up, targeting configured, and creatives uploaded. Ready to publish with a single click.
steps.notes:
ADAPT FOR YOUR NICHE:
- Research optimal targeting parameters for {niche} (age ranges, interests, behaviors)
- Set up conversion tracking (pixel/CAPI) on the client website before running ads
- Create Custom and Lookalike Audiences if client has customer data
- Set up automated rules for budget management
- Consider multiple ad platforms if {niche} audiences are on Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, etc.
- Create a standardized naming convention for multi-client management

subSteps.title: Create Campaign
subSteps.description: Open Ads Manager and create the campaign with objective and budget.
subSteps.prompt: Open {ad_platform} Ads Manager. Create a new campaign named '{client_name} - {agency_name} - {current_month} {current_year}'. Set objective to Traffic, daily budget to ${daily_budget}, start today with no end date.

subSteps.title: Configure Ad Sets with Targeting
subSteps.description: Create ad sets with geographic, demographic, and interest targeting appropriate for {niche}.
subSteps.prompt: Create one ad set per ad type. Set geographic targeting to {radius}-mile radius around {client_address}. Configure age range, interests, and behaviors appropriate for {niche}. Use automatic placements. Optimize for link clicks.

subSteps.title: Upload Creatives and Copy
subSteps.description: Upload images and fill in all ad copy fields.
subSteps.prompt: For each ad, upload the creative, fill in headline, primary text, and description. Set CTA button. Set destination URL with UTM parameters: utm_source={ad_platform}&utm_medium=paid&utm_campaign={campaign_name}.

subSteps.title: Review and Save as Draft
subSteps.description: Preview all ads and save the campaign in draft status.
subSteps.prompt: Preview every ad across all placements. Verify images, text truncation, links, and geo-targeting. Save the entire campaign as DRAFT. Create a summary of all ad sets and ads.

steps.title: Lead Generation (Prospect List)
steps.description: Generate a prospect list of businesses in {niche} that the agency can reach out to. Search the target geographic area, compile business information and social media handles into a structured spreadsheet, and prioritize by likelihood to convert.
steps.prompt:
I want to start getting clients for my AI ad agency. I need a prospect list of {niche} businesses I can reach out to.

1. Search for {niche} businesses within {radius} miles of {location}
2. Find at least 20 businesses (aim for 25-30)
3. For each business, gather:
   - Business name
   - Physical address
   - Phone number
   - Website URL
   - {outreach_platform} handle/profile
   - Facebook page URL
   - Owner or marketing manager name (if findable)
   - Estimated size (small / mid-size / large)
   - Whether they appear to be running {ad_platform} ads currently
   - Brief notes on their current online presence quality

4. Organize into a clean spreadsheet
5. Sort by priority:
   - HIGH: Businesses with weak online presence but clear need (they need our help most)
   - MEDIUM: Already running ads but with room for improvement
   - LOW: Sophisticated operations (harder to sell to)

6. Add a "Personalization Hook" column with one specific observation per business for outreach

Save as a structured spreadsheet.
steps.expectedOutput: A spreadsheet with 20-30 businesses including all contact info, social handles, priority ranking, and personalization hooks. Sorted with HIGH priority at the top.
steps.notes:
ADAPT FOR YOUR NICHE:
- Identify {niche}-specific directories and review sites to check (e.g., Yelp, industry directories)
- Check Google Business profiles for review counts and ratings
- Look for businesses that recently opened or changed ownership
- Check for job postings (hiring marketing = open to outsourcing)
- Consider using data enrichment tools (Apollo.io, Hunter.io) for verified emails
- Build a CRM pipeline instead of just a spreadsheet
- Tag prospects by sub-niche or specialization within {niche}

subSteps.title: Search for Local {niche} Businesses
subSteps.description: Find 20-30 businesses in {niche} in the target area.
subSteps.prompt: Search Google Maps for '{niche} near {location}' within {radius} miles. List every business with name, address, phone, and website. Also check industry directories. Aim for 25+ results.

subSteps.title: Gather Social Media Profiles
subSteps.description: Find social media profiles for each business.
subSteps.prompt: For each business, search {outreach_platform} and Facebook for their official profiles. Record handles/URLs, follower counts, and last post dates.

subSteps.title: Assess and Prioritize Prospects
subSteps.description: Evaluate online presence and assign priority rankings.
subSteps.prompt: For each business, visit their website and check {ad_platform} Ad Library. Rate their online presence. Assign priority (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW). Write a personalization hook for each.

subSteps.title: Compile Final Spreadsheet
subSteps.description: Organize all data into a sorted spreadsheet.
subSteps.prompt: Compile all data into a clean spreadsheet. Columns: Business Name, Address, Phone, Website, {outreach_platform} Handle, Facebook, Contact Name, Size, Running Ads (Y/N), Online Presence Rating, Priority, Personalization Hook. Sort by priority. Save as spreadsheet.

steps.title: Automated Outreach ({outreach_platform})
steps.description: Execute outreach to prospective clients via {outreach_platform}. Send personalized messages to each business from the prospect list. Consider platform Terms of Service and use personalization to improve response rates.
steps.prompt:
I need you to reach out to the {niche} businesses on our prospect list via {outreach_platform}.

Prospect list: {prospect_spreadsheet_from_step_7}

For each business:
1. Open {outreach_platform} in the browser
2. Search for the business
3. Navigate to their profile
4. Send a personalized pitch message

**Message Template** (personalize for each business):

---
Hi [Business Name] team!

I noticed [personalization hook from spreadsheet].

I run an AI-powered ad agency specifically for {niche} businesses. We create high-converting ad creatives using your real products/services/inventory data and deploy them directly to {ad_platform}.

Here is what makes us different:
- Ads use YOUR real data (no stock photos, no generic copy)
- New ads generated automatically when you update your offerings
- Strategy based on what top {niche} businesses are running
- Everything set up and managed for you

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute call this week? I can show you sample ads I created using your actual website.

Here is my calendar: {calendar_booking_link}

[Your Name]

steps.title: Automated Monitoring & Continuous Ad Generation
steps.description: Set up an automated system that monitors client websites for new products/services/inventory and automatically generates and deploys ads. This transforms the agency from a manual workflow into a fully autonomous system with near-zero ongoing fulfillment cost.
steps.prompt:
I need you to help me design and set up an automated monitoring system for my {niche} clients.

1. **Website Monitoring**:
   - Check {client_website} every {check_interval}
   - Compare current offerings to the last snapshot
   - Detect: new items added, items removed, price changes, new promotions

2. **Automatic Ad Generation Triggers**:
   When new content detected:
   - Pull all details
   - Generate ad creative using brand style guide
   - Create ad copy using strategy playbook
   
   When price change detected:
   - Generate a special offer ad
   - Update existing ads
   
   When item removed:
   - Flag active ads for pausing

3. **Automated Deployment**:
   - Create new ads in {ad_platform} Ads Manager
   - Use existing campaign structure and targeting
   - Optionally require human approval before publishing
   - Auto-pause ads for removed items

4. **Reporting**:
   - Daily summary: changes detected, ads created, ads paused
   - Weekly performance report
   - Monthly client report with ROI analysis

5. **Technical Implementation**:
   - Recommend the best approach (scheduled agent, API, or hybrid)
   - Outline the implementation plan
   - Document tools, scheduling, and error handling

Provide a detailed technical specification.
steps.expectedOutput: A technical specification for the automated monitoring system including: architecture, monitoring logic, ad generation triggers, deployment workflow, reporting templates, and phased implementation plan.
steps.notes:
ADAPT FOR YOUR NICHE:
- Define what 'inventory changes' means for {niche} (new products? menu updates? listings?)
- Identify the refresh frequency appropriate for {niche} (hourly for fast-moving, daily for stable)
- Build a multi-client dashboard for monitoring all accounts
- Add anomaly detection (website down, sudden inventory drop)
- Implement A/B testing automation for ad variants
- Add creative refresh scheduling
- Consider external triggers (weather, events, holidays) relevant to {niche}
- Build a client portal for visibility
- Consider productizing this as SaaS if scaling beyond a few clients

subSteps.title: Design System Architecture
subSteps.description: Create the technical architecture for automated monitoring and ad generation.
subSteps.prompt: Design the system architecture: components (scraper, database, ad generator, deployer, reporter), data flow, storage, scheduling, and error handling. Recommend tools and technologies. Create an architecture diagram or description.

subSteps.title: Build Website Scraper
subSteps.description: Create a script that monitors client websites for changes.
subSteps.prompt: Create a script that scrapes {client_website} for current offerings, compares against stored snapshots, identifies new items, removed items, and price changes, and outputs a change report. Include error handling for website changes and downtime.

subSteps.title: Build Auto-Ad Pipeline
subSteps.description: Create the pipeline connecting detection to ad generation.
subSteps.prompt: Build the pipeline: when scraper detects a new item, auto-populate ad template with real data, generate copy following brand guide and playbook, create creative, queue for deployment. Include a togglable human approval gate.

subSteps.title: Set Up Scheduling and Reporting
subSteps.description: Configure monitoring schedule and automated reports.
subSteps.prompt: Set up: scraper runs every {check_interval}, ad generator triggers on changes, deployer batches daily. Create report templates: daily summary, weekly performance, monthly ROI. Configure email delivery.
